The interior maximizer c=13/24 has value 25/48>1/2, greater than every outer-piece value, so B. Preserve H-approved geometric probability with all three optional quadratic-vertex, square-completion and polynomial-derivative routes. Only the middle quadratic is differentiated, and the outer intervals are checked. Uniform marginal distributions alone do not imply independence; retain that ordinary model qualification with normal grading rather than silently converting it into a confirmed defect.
